definitions.gloss: glutinous rice flour; sweet rice flour; mochi flour
definitions.explanation: Flour made from glutinous rice (mochigome), used to make mochi and other traditional Japanese sweets.

examples.japanese: {餅粉|もちこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make dango from glutinous rice flour.

examples.japanese: {餅粉|もちこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: Add water to the mochi flour and knead it well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{餅粉|もちこ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{上新粉|じょうしんこ}→上新粉：28740_joushinko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んで→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: In the wagashi class, we learned the difference between glutinous rice flour and non-glutinous rice flour before making daifuku.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ (mochi/rice cake) and {粉|こ} (flour/powder). Made by drying and grinding {餅米|もちごめ} (glutinous rice), this flour produces the characteristic soft, stretchy texture of mochi and many Japanese sweets.

Not to be confused with ⟦{上新粉|じょうしんこ}→上新粉：28740_joushinko⟧, which is made from non-glutinous rice ({粳米|うるちまい}) and produces a firmer texture. ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧ is another glutinous rice flour, but processed differently — the rice is soaked and ground wet, then dried, producing finer granules.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餅粉|もちこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make with mochi flour
- {餅粉|もちこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to knead mochi flour
- {餅粉|もちこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まぶす→まぶす：18477_mabusu⟧: to dust with mochi flour

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧: another type of glutinous rice flour (wet-ground)
- {餅米|もちごめ}: glutinous rice
- ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧: potato starch
